newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Heshe to place 28 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Heshe to place 28 mln new shares.

text.p: Retailer and garment manufacturer Heshe Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to place out privately 28 million new ordinary shares.
The shares, representing approximately 10 percent of the company's existing issued capital, will be sold at Singapore $0.40 each, Heshe said in a statement.
The placement would be made via securities firm Ong & Co.

"When completed, the private placement will increase the issued and paid-up capital of the company as at October 24, 1996 from S$71 million comprising 284 million ordinary shares of S$0.25 each to S$78 million (of) 312 million," it said.
